forgotPassword.title: Recover password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email you a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If the details match an account, you'll receive an email with a reset link in the next few minutes. The link expires in 1 hour.
forgotPassword.email.label: Email
forgotPassword.email.hint: Enter the email you used to register your account.
forgotPassword.error: We couldn't process your request. Check your connection and try again.
forgotPassword.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
resetPassword.title: Create your new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Your new password replaces the old one and signs out any active sessions.
resetPassword.newPassword.label: New password
resetPassword.newPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
resetPassword.success: Password updated. Taking you to sign in…
resetPassword.error.expired.title: Link expired
resetPassword.error.expired.message: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one from the sign-in screen.
resetPassword.error.server.title: Can't reach the server
resetPassword.error.server.message: Check your connection and try again.
changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.subtitle: One step before you start working.
changePassword.notice.title: This password isn't yours yet
changePassword.notice.message: It was created for you by an administrator, who also knows it. Choose your own to continue — until you do, the rest of the app stays locked.
changePassword.currentPassword.label: Temporary password
changePassword.currentPassword.placehold: The one you just signed in with
changePassword.currentPassword.required: Enter the password you signed in with
changePassword.newPassword.label: New password
changePassword.newPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
changePassword.error.credentials.title: That password doesn't match
changePassword.error.credentials.message: Type the temporary password exactly as you received it.
changePassword.error.unchanged.title: Pick a different password
changePassword.error.unchanged.message: The new password has to be different from the temporary one.
changePassword.error.server.title: Can't reach the server
changePassword.error.server.message: Check your connection and try again.
login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Admin Portal
login.tenantSlug.label: Company identifier
login.tenantSlug.help: The one you chose at signup. Leave blank if you're a user of the original system.
login.username.label: Username
login.password.label: Password
login.error.invalidCredentials.title: We could not sign you in
login.error.invalidCredentials.message: The username or password does not match. Check the company identifier too.
login.error.accessRestricted.title: Access restricted
login.error.accessRestricted.message: Your user or your company is deactivated in BuildTrack. Talk to your company's administrator.
login.error.serverDown.title: Can't reach the server
login.error.serverDown.message: Check your connection and try again. If it persists, the panel may be under maintenance.
login.error.sessionExpired.title: Session expired
login.error.sessionExpired.message: For your security we closed your session. Sign in again to continue.
login.hero.title: Your jobsites, your crew and your money
login.hero.body: Geofenced clock-ins from the phone, approved hours, payroll, invoices and budgets. All in one panel.
login.error.accessRestricted.tenant: The company is suspended in BuildTrack. Talk to your company's administrator or to support.
login.error.staleSession.title: A previous session is still stored
login.error.staleSession.message: It is not your password: this browser still holds a previous session the server already closed, and that is what it rejected. Clear this site's cookies or sign in from a private window.
